notes: Owner's manuals: VIN required for all years (vw.com: 'For models 2023 and newer Enter your VIN'; 'For models 2012-2022 Visit our maintenance website' where the owner's manual is retrieved only with a VIN). Free without VIN (select Model Year/Model/Trim on maintenance.vw.com): official US owner's-literature PDFs - Warranty and Maintenance booklet (all-model, per MY) and Maintenance Card; also available but not listed here: Tire Warranty summary, 24h Roadside guide, Collision brochure, California emissions warranty. Document URLs are stable UUID links on ownersliterature.vw.com (VW Group of America). Model codes = first 3 chars of the sales model code (e.g. Jetta 162/163/BU3/BU4/BU5, Passat A32/A33/A34, Tiguan 5N2/BW2/BJ2/CL1/RM1, Atlas CA1/CA2/CA3, Arteon 3H7/3H8, Touareg 7P5/7P6). Jetta GLI shares the Jetta model code and documents. Atlas Cross Sport, Jetta Hybrid and Jetta SportWagen (2014) were not mapped.
